sn12.67:1.1: The two great arahants often engaged each other in erudite Dhamma discussions for their own enjoyment or the education of their students.
sn12.67:4.3: For the mutual conditioning of name and form with consciousness see [sn12.65:2.16]() and notes there.
sn12.67:7.4: _Niśraya_ in the sense of “leaning” a ladder against a post is found at Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa 5.2.1.9.
